limits: No real campaign was harvested or interpreted during these tests.
The bulky raw input inventory is not reread in full; the terminal record states this explicitly.
The helper never publishes externally. A downstream worker must match the receipt publication hash and canonical bundle hash.
scope: Scratch finite completion handoff; fictional fixtures and toy child only
verified_cases: Wait for the terminal driver without launching estimators; stop on campaign failure.
Pin the reviewed collector and renderer, candidate03 protocol, exact 89-file source snapshot and native executable; recheck before and after collection.
Require check-only success before collect with the explicit source03 override and 1,650-fit design.
Keep the destination flock inherited by the child; duplicate locking fails without altering status.
Save atomic status and numbered retained transitions; never overwrite logs.
Do not retry readiness or collection failures. Interrupted waiting can resume; interrupted collection without a terminal bundle blocks.
Resume after an atomic bundle rename by verification alone, without another collector invocation.
Verify existing bundle identity, exact listed files, original byte payloads including gzip, and figure/input/postprocessing hashes.
Verify all 1,650 unique metrics case/method rows against archived run and frozen input inventories, including checkpoint and validity identities.
Verify every calibration score and every invalid calibration/evaluation row remains in failures, and summary failure counts agree.
Reject missing, duplicate or unfrozen metrics, dropped failures, fictional figures, unlisted bytes and changes to completed manifests.
Enforce the 95 MiB cap even for listed artifacts with matching hashes.
